html:
As a TikTok Affiliate Program (TAP) agency, finding products that are likely to perform well across different campaign types takes time. The High opportunity product pool helps solve this problem.

What It Is

The High opportunity product pool is an aggregator tool that brings together products with strong sales and commission potential from all campaign types - Seller, Agency, Exclusive TikTok shop, and more.

Key Features and Benefits

  1. Find Products That Perform: Access carefully selected products from all your campaigns in one tab. Instead of searching through multiple campaign types separately, you'll spot promising products quickly.
  2. Choose Products With Confidence: See products from different campaigns side-by-side and easily identify ones with attractive commission rates. Add them to your campaigns with just a few clicks.
  3. Run Better Campaigns: Focus on products chosen for their performance potential. Add them to your campaigns easily and spend less time searching for good options.
  4. Work Well with Creators: Give products to creators and set their commission rates in one place. Create and share product lists directly through the platform instead of sending individual links from different campaign types.

How it works

Step 1: If you already have a TikTok Shop Partner Center account, navigate to Product Management and select high opportunity products. You will be able to search for products by name/id/shopname/shopcode/campaign name/campaign id. And it supports batch search by Product id.

Step 2: Use the advanced filters for more granular results. Step 3: A product could belong to multiple campaigns, choose the campaign you would like to join and click "Select"

How to view Removed Products & Status?

Step 4: Once you have selected the product and joined the campaign, the product will appear under Selected Products and you can set your commission Step 5: You can create a product list by selecting multiple products and copying the link and sending it to creators Creator's Experience: If you send the creator a product list, they will see a list of products. If you send them just one product, they will see that single product.

Q&A

How to view Removed Products & Status?

  1. When go to the Product Pool page, I can see products that have been removed.
    1. Product Unavailable in All Campaigns: Then its status is shown as “Unavailable” directly on the list.

  1. Product Available in Some Campaigns: When I click on such a product, Then I am taken to a detail page that shows its per-campaign availability status (“Available” or “Unavailable”).
